name: FlexFactor
historical_purpose: A local dual-provider refactorer that grew into a managed purpose-driven audit, repair, verification, and publication system.
purpose: Be a trustworthy local expert that audits or improves code without retaining unverified changes, leaking sensitive source, or executing untrusted dependencies outside containment, while producing reproducible evidence and deterministic rollback.

current_behavior.text: One durable orchestrator admits 1 through 30 targets sequentially.
Audit and Production Ready use at most six passes: the whole repository, a configurable competitor gate defaulting to 25, then verified edit deltas.
Owner coding uses subscriptions before metered APIs and then free/local, strongest first per class. All cloud, CLI, Cursor and research payloads obey the egress gate.
One run shares author-family identity; final review requires a non-author family or fails closed.
Checkpoints stay local; changed-run completion requires green gates, exact-commit independent review, and remote-default ancestry proof.
Android persists the queue; cloud claims request UUIDs atomically, recovers dispatch after crashes, and removes phone-supplied secrets at terminal status.

aspirations.text: OS-enforced Windows network isolation in addition to current process-tree and resource controls.

users.text: Owners running Refactor, Scout, Audit, or Production Ready from Android, desktop launchers, or CLI.
Supervisors consuming statuses, receipts, manifests, error ledgers, and evidence bundles.

outcomes.text: Verified corrections reach the authoritative default branch without force-push; owner WIP is restored by fingerprint.
Incomplete provider, verification, review, publication, or release conditions stay BLOCKED or IN PROGRESS.

workflows.text: Audit checks purpose, repository, competitors, and verified deltas, then verifies, independently reviews, and publishes.
Production Ready adds the full readiness rubric to Audit.
Scout researches improvements; mutation requires explicit authorization and normal verification and publication.
Refactor changes selected files only after project verification, independent review, and publication proof.

invariants.text: Audit/Production Ready attempt repair and publication, never report-only. Scout apply requires authorization.
Verifier outage restores exact pre-run bytes, fails the run, and creates no UNVERIFIED commit or success score.
Owner WIP never becomes an ancestor of a FlexFactor-published branch.
Partial output never authorizes clean, ready, approval, commit publication, or merge.
Untrusted dependencies run only under enforced resource, network, path, process, and time containment on Windows and Linux; unavailable controls BLOCK.
Every claimed gate must have run; unknown and unavailable are not passes.
A changed run cannot exit successfully until the exact reviewed SHA is proven on the authoritative remote default branch.
No reviewer from any candidate author family can certify the final commit.
Source is classified before cloud calls; sensitive repositories use local processing unless the owner explicitly approves an exception.
Every modification binds to batch/project budgets, an immutable manifest, exact commands/evidence, tests, commit identity, and deterministic rollback.

acceptance_criteria: A. Queue 1-30 targets sequentially; never overlap targets.
B. Pass 1 covers the repository; passes 2-6 equal the prior verified delta.
C. Evaluate the configured corroborated-competitor target between passes 1 and 2; the default is 25 and explicit run limits are honored.
D. Owner coding uses subscriptions, metered APIs, then free/local.
E. Target-controlled commands cross the execution broker.
F. Analyze every relevant file completely or name the blocker.
G. Cite purpose sources, contradictions, unknowns, and confidence before mutation.
H. Partial or malformed output cannot authorize clean or approval.
I. Retained corrections pass the real build and strongest suite.
J. Final review excludes every candidate author family.
K. Independent review covers the exact-commit patch in addressed chunks.
L. HEAD movement after review revokes approval.
M. Rescan, blast radius, secrets, and direct coverage complete or BLOCK.
N. Live UI journeys cover roles, routes, controls, forms, accessibility, and performance.
O. Capture WIP outside candidate ancestry; restore only on matching fingerprint.
P. Audit and Production Ready run real repair and publication; Scout apply requires explicit authorization; never push checkpoints or force-push.
Q. Protected branches use PRs and remain incomplete until merged.
R. Fresh fetch proves the reviewed SHA on the authoritative default branch.
S. Wheel, cloud, APK, and source identify the same release.
T. Production ready requires merged main, exact-SHA CI, deployed cloud, signed APK, and live proof.
U. Classify source before cloud calls; sensitive repos default local absent explicit approval.
V. Contain untrusted commands with enforced resource, network, path, process, and time limits on Windows/Linux.
W. Bind each modification to budgets, immutable manifest, exact commands/evidence, tests, commit, and rollback.
X. Windows/Linux outage, dirty-worktree, cancellation, timeout, partial-failure, and backward-compatibility tests pass.

resolved_contradictions.text: The earlier report-only default contradicted the standing owner instruction.
resolved_contradictions.resolution: Audit and Production Ready perform real repair/publication with no dry-run path. Scout apply remains explicitly authorized. The September 12 Obsidian handoff reaffirms this instruction.

gaps.text: Windows raw-socket isolation is best effort, so untrusted dependency execution cannot yet satisfy the containment requirement.
The complete Windows/Linux dirty-worktree, cancellation, timeout, partial-failure, and backward-compatibility matrix is not yet evidenced.

evidence.excerpt: Dispatch, downgrade guard, and scoped cleanup.

false_substitutes: Build pass without the strongest suite.
HTTP health without authenticated workflow proof.
Tests not run on the exact candidate.
Commit or PR without independent verification.
Module import counted as direct execution.
Checkpoint without SHA and policy verification.
